page.notes: The Greek line is copied from the scan; the word ἀνεξετάσους is doubtful and is marked [?]. The line ends with a printed hyphen on "con-", which continues on the next part. The first line is a fragment ending "tra Maximinum." Some words, such as "utriq;" and "Rō.I.", are read from small italic type and are not fully certain.
